items.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a brand-new editorial lifestyle running photograph, vertical 4:5, for a Korean running-community card cover. Two adult friends jogging comfortably side by side AWAY from camera on an ordinary unidentifiable tree-lined park asphalt path. Both full bodies and all feet visible in middle distance, occupying upper-middle/right portion, lots of uncluttered path in bottom quarter for later typography. One charcoal neutral athletic outfit and one off-white neutral athletic outfit, plain unbranded shoes. Quiet companionship and relaxed natural stride, not a competition or sprint. Natural soft daylight, muted green foliage, restrained saturation, realistic skin/clothing/path texture, candid and understated, no dramatic commercial sports lighting. Preserve both people and their relationship in 4:5 crop. NO text, NO logos, NO watermarks, NO graphics, NO typography. Generate only the photographic asset, not a card layout.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Brand-new editorial running photograph, landscape 4:3. Close low side-rear view of TWO adult friends jogging comfortably side by side on a neighborhood park asphalt path. Frame from mid-thigh down, include all four anatomically natural lower legs and whole shoes without cutting off toes. One wears plain charcoal shorts, one off-white shorts, both white socks and plain unbranded off-white running shoes. Subtle natural differing strides, no racing or synchronized impossible pose. Soft natural daylight, muted greens in distant background, gray textured pavement, realistic fabric and shoes, restrained saturation. Keep feet grouped in center with generous path margin all around for later horizontal cropping. Candid everyday companionship. NO text, NO lettering, NO logos, NO watermark. Only a photograph, no card layout.

Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the THIRD input photo (c04), using FIRST input c01 as the identity and wardrobe reference and SECOND input c03 as lower-body wardrobe reference. Replace only the two people in c04 with the SAME two fictional adult East Asian runners from c01: man short black hair, clean-shaven, charcoal short-sleeved athletic tee and dark shorts; woman dark ponytail, off-white long-sleeved hooded lightweight windbreaker and off-white shorts. Preserve their build, hair, apparent age and natural skin tone from c01. Both white socks and unbranded off-white running shoes consistent with c03. Keep c04 composition: both full-body figures on lower right, relaxed jogging together towards camera, faces naturally consistent with the reference rather than the old c04 faces. Keep the park path, foliage, soft natural daylight, restrained green/gray palette, background perspective, generous upper-left negative space and 4:5 portrait framing unchanged. All feet visible. Photorealistic candid understated scene, no text, logo, watermark, graphics. Identity and outfit continuity across the series is the primary goal. Output only the edited c04 photograph.
